About

I'm a project engineer at Dunn's Valve Testers in Houston, where I take automated valve test systems from requirements through design release, fabrication, testing and commissioning at customer sites across the U.S.

At Texas A&M I built robotic hands, animatronic mechanisms, UR robot workcells and embedded controllers, and led the student teams that assembled and documented them.

Native Spanish speaker, intermediate French.

DWGVP25&75-10412026

4-Station Valve Test Frame

VP25 & VP75 · Dunn's Valve Testers

Autodesk InventorMachine designSafety guardingDesign release

What

  • Four-station hydraulic test frame that tests 1.5" through 4" NPT and flanged valves side by side.
  • Each station has its own ram, seal-plate interface and safety window, with a shared operating panel, PLC cabinet and back enclosure.

How

  • Engineered the frame and station tooling in Autodesk Inventor.
  • Station-specific top seal plates with O-ring grooves, ram mount and base plates for 5-in and 6-in ram ends, and enclosure brackets.
  • Led the drafting team and reviewed and approved the fabrication drawing package.

Results

  • ~4,900 lb frame released to fabrication with a full general-arrangement and part-drawing package.
  • Dedicated tooling per station for NPT and flanged valves from 1.5" to 4".

DWGRF400-10252026

Large-Valve Hydrostatic Test System

RF400 · Dunn's Valve Testers

System schematicsPLC/HMI electricalHydraulicsWater systems

What

  • Large-bore valve test system: heavy test frame with top and bottom seal plates, a 400-gallon high-volume water skid, hydraulic power unit and HMI control panel.
  • Clamps valves with openings from 12" up to 47¼" and includes valve-exerciser stations.

How

  • Authored the complete 10-sheet system schematic set: test control, machine test circuit, water skid, HPU and machine hydraulics, PLC, HMI, HPU and machine electrical, plus connector and cable schedules.
  • Reviewed and approved the valve-exerciser mounting bracket and extrusion shaft.
  • Coordinated the frame, skid, HPU and control panel as one integrated machine.

Results

  • System approved for manufacture (June 2026).
  • ~40,000 lb test frame integrated with a 4,100 lb water skid, HPU and HMI panel.

Pressure Hold

A hydrostatic test you are allowed to fail

TESTPH-001HYDRO
Valve1
Score0
Best0
Seals◆◆◆

Pressure Hold

Bring each valve up to its test pressure and hold it inside the band until the ring around the gauge closes. The valve leaks and the pump lags.

Hold to run. You can also press and hold on the gauge to pump. P or Esc pauses.

The test

  • Each valve gets a test pressure and a tolerance band.
  • Stay in the band until the hold timer fills. Drift out and the timer drains.

The catch

  • The pump takes a moment to respond and the valve leaks.
  • From valve 3, seals start to weep. Above 9,500 psi the relief valve lifts and the valve fails.

Scoring

  • 100 per valve, up to 100 more for staying near the target, plus 5 per second left.
  • Fail three valves and the shift is over.

Flea Hop

Thread a flea through the scalp

GAMEFH-002SCALP
Score0
Best0

Flea Hop

Hop your flea through the gaps between hairs and combs. Gravity is not on your side, and neither is the skin.

Tap the scene, click, or press Space to hop. P or Esc pauses.

The goal

  • Hop between the hairs and combs without touching either one.
  • Every gap you clear is one point.

The hazards

  • Hair follicles grow thick bundles of hair from the scalp above and below.
  • Combs reach in from above and below, and their teeth are packed too tight to squeeze between. The skin counts as a wall too.

The catch

  • Each hop is short and gravity is not. Tap in rhythm instead of mashing.
  • The scalp scrolls faster and the gaps tighten as your score climbs.
